statement: Submit at least 20 paired [control, treatment] latency measurements in integer microseconds for an intervention on the same workload. Accepted when the pinned two-sided paired permutation test, run with seed 0 over 20000 rounds, reports p <= 0.01 -- that is, a statistic of at most 10000 parts per million. The test and the threshold are fixed by this objective and cannot be renegotiated after the measurements exist.
